name: Ceridian Dayforce
description_en:
Ceridian Dayforce is a product in the Human resources category. Its directory profile covers Training Management, Time Off Management, Recruiting Management, Performance Appraisal, Payroll Management, Onboarding, Employee Lifecycle Management, Employee Database.

Additional listed capabilities include HR Compliance Management, Time & Attendance Management, Applicant Tracking, Self Service Portal, Compensation Management, Benefits Management, 360 Degree Feedback. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: prepare payroll records and payment calculations; store structured information about employees; track candidates through a hiring process; organize employee benefits and enrollment records. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

Ceridian Dayforce 属于人力资源软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括培训管理、休假管理、招聘管理、绩效评估、薪资管理、入职引导、员工生命周期管理、员工资料库。

资料还列出人事合规管理、工时与考勤管理、求职申请跟踪、自助服务门户、薪酬管理、福利管理、360 度反馈。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：整理薪资记录并计算工资支付；集中保存结构化员工资料；跟踪候选人在招聘流程中的进展；整理员工福利及参保记录。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
